preconditions.description: The length of the Prophesy does not exceed 100,000 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789-' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The Prophesy consists only of digits and hyphens.
The Prophesy is a non-empty string.

postconditions.description: The output date is a substring of the Prophesy.

postconditions.expression: any(date in stdin for date in [f'{d:02d}-{m:02d}-{y}' for y in range(2013, 2016) for m in range(1, 13) for d in range(1, 32) if (m in {1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12} and d <= 31) or (m in {4, 6, 9, 11} and d <= 30) or (m == 2 and d <= 28)])
postconditions.description: The output date is a valid date mentioned in the Prophesy.

postconditions.expression: all(count(stdout) > count(date) for date in [f'{d:02d}-{m:02d}-{y}' for y in range(2013, 2016) for m in range(1, 13) for d in range(1, 32) if (m in {1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12} and d <= 31) or (m in {4, 6, 9, 11} and d <= 30) or (m == 2 and d <= 28)])
postconditions.description: The output date occurs more times in the Prophesy than any other valid date.
